violation.guideSubtitle: From a profile, vehicle details, or booking.

violation.guideDisclaimer: A violation report doesn't issue a refund or replace a dispute. If you need help using the app, submit a support request.
violation.searchPlaceholder: Name, license plate, or booking code…

violation.emptyHint: You can change the filters or open the item you want to report to submit a report.

create.targetNotice: The target is attached from the screen you're viewing. Reports are verified and aren't a violation conclusion.

create.viewSentMessage: Your current content hasn't been submitted and won't be saved.
